about: What /llms.txt says to agents and other programs, written at each build by indexer/llms.js. {url}, {snapshot}, {source}, {userAgent} and {hours} are filled from config; the record types, the docs and the counts are added from the lexicons, docs/ and the snapshot.
intro: {name} ({url}) lists open jobs at organizations that hire, read straight from each one's own job board (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Personio, Recruitee, Rippling, SmartRecruiters, Workable), and lists of organizations curated by people on atproto (the Bluesky protocol): every record lives in its author's own account. Open source (GPL-3.0), no ads, no tracking, no accounts of its own.
lead: All the data is public and free to read. Prefer the snapshot files below over crawling the pages: they hold everything the pages show, in a few requests. Jobs from job boards link to the organization's own posting: apply there. Jobs posted on joblist have their own page.

pages.title: Home
pages.about: what joblist is, a job search and the ways in

pages.title: Job search
pages.about: every open job, searchable by job, city and on a map (`/jobs#q=design&where=Berlin`)

pages.title: Jobs by city
pages.about: one page per city with enough jobs, e.g. `/in/berlin`, `/in/berlin/design`, older jobs at `?page=2`

pages.title: Organizations
pages.about: one page per organization at its domain, `/{domain}`, e.g. `/ableton.com` (an account's handle the same way)

pages.title: Lists
pages.about: lists of organizations made by people, at `/{handle}/{rkey}`; each person's at `/{handle}`

pages.title: Sitemap
pages.about: the pages; the pages per city and field in `/sitemap-places.xml`

feeds.title: Any search
feeds.about: `/feed/search.xml?q=design&where=Berlin` (the explorer's search, words after the `#`, as a query)

snapshot.about: every open job (large: prefer the smaller files). Compact keys: `t` title, `u` link, `c` organization key (its domain), `l` location, `d` department, `p` first seen (ISO date), `i` id at its board, `r` onsite/hybrid/remote (said by its board, or clearly by its text), `g` [longitude, latitude], `m` pay [min, max, currency, period], `s` atproto record of a job posted on joblist, `v` posted by the organization itself
one organization's open jobs, small, with the same keys; `checked`: its board was read, `gone`: its board closed
one list (its DID did:plc:abc as plc/abc)'s organizations (`companies`, `names`) and their open jobs, small, with the same keys; shown on any site with `<joblist-jobs list="{did}/{rkey}">` (/embed)
every organization, list, suggestion and job record, with their authors' handles
open jobs per organization, and per list in its place
the cities and fields with a page, and their job counts; `landing/in/{city}.json`, `landing/field/{field}.json`: their newest jobs
when the snapshot was made, and counts

etiquette: The snapshot is rebuilt every {hours} hours: reading it more often gives nothing new.
joblist's own requests to job boards and other services say `{userAgent}`; each job's description is read once, not at every run.
Link to an organization's page here, or to its job's own posting; never copy applications through joblist, it has none.
An organization that wants its jobs left out, or a fix: describe it on joblist with its own account (its handle is its domain), or open an issue at {source}/issues.
